subject: [PATCH v2 01/12] mm/khugepaged: drop redundant mm_struct pin in madvise_collapse()

2026-09-10.patch_summary: This patch removes unnecessary mm_struct pinning in the madvise_collapse() function, which is already holding a reference to the memory map through other means. The redundant mmgrab() and mmdrop() calls are dropped, simplifying the code and reducing potential issues with memory management.
